name: Top 10 countdown
description: Ranked countdowns from number ten to number one about records in nature, geography and space.

definition.brief: Each video ranks ten things in one subject, from number ten down to number one: the fastest, biggest, oldest, loudest or strangest. Every entry is real and accurate, gets one short reason for its place, and the countdown builds to a satisfying number one.
topics: the biggest moons in the solar system
definition.music_mood: punchy, upbeat electronic music with a driving beat that builds toward the end

intro_line.en: Welcome to {series}. Let's count them down!

outro_line.en: Thanks for watching. See you at the next countdown!
